author: John Dowland
note: ATTRIBUTION CAVEAT from the sourcing cell: Bullen's 1887 preface states 'as a rule, the composers are responsible only for the music', naming Campion as the exception who wrote both. Dowland's file is staged as SONG-BOOK LYRICS UNDER HIS BOOKS, not as verse he is proved to have written. Fifth composer-attribution problem on this list.

author: John Hill Hewitt
note: caution: 'All Quiet Along the Potomac' is reachable but the WORDS are Ethel Lynn Beers's — who is on this list as Ethelinda Beers. Attributing it to Hewitt would credit the composer and lose the lyricist.
